name: Wildfire
author: Erin Carter
description: An emission nebula seen deep-field: luminous palette-tinted gas in pink and blue regions, threaded by dark dust lanes, with two or three ragged expanding ionization shells lit warm-to-cool across their stroke and beaded with brighter star-forming knots. The interiors the shells have swept read as denser glowing cloud, and a twinkling multi-layer starfield sits over it all, the brightest stars haloing into soft spikes.

params.label: Expansion rate
params.effect: How fast each gas shell dilates outward.

params.label: Filament width
params.effect: Stroke width in CSS pixels of the glowing ionization shells.

params.label: Knot intensity
params.effect: Brightness boost of the star-forming knots strung along the shells; zero evens them out.

params.label: Turbulence
params.effect: How strongly turbulence distorts the shells; zero spreads them as clean rings.

params.label: Star density
params.effect: How many stars populate the field, from a sparse scatter to a dense sky.

params.label: Gas amount
params.effect: Brightness and coverage of the nebula gas field; zero leaves only shells and stars on black.
